name: @elysia/node
description: Elysia adapter to run Elysia on Node.js

scripts.test: bun run test:node && bun run test:node-cluster
scripts.test:node: npm install --prefix ./test/node/cjs/ && npm install --prefix ./test/node/esm/ && node ./test/node/cjs/index.js && node ./test/node/esm/index.js
scripts.test:node-cluster: node ./test/cluster/cluster.cjs port && node ./test/cluster/cluster.cjs object && node ./test/cluster/cluster.cjs true && node ./test/cluster/cluster.cjs false
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run test && npm publish --access public
